title: REAR VENT PLENUM TO REAR UPPER PANEL
summary: Convertible (19467) rear deck vent plenums (the air exhaust vents in the rear upper panel behind the convertible top / rear deck): a center plenum with baffle and the side plenums are bonded to the rear upper body panel and underbody (bonds B, E, K, N). No mechanical fasteners; 50n cement is wadded at the plenum ends.

materials.where: outer end of side plenum [3] (View A and top view at the RH plenum)

fastening.to: panel-body rear upper and underbody asm
fastening.note: Center plenum [1] and baffle [2] bonded with bond B to the rear upper panel and underbody.

fastening.to: panel-body rear upper and underbody asm
fastening.note: View A: side plenum [3] bonded with bonds B, E, K and N.
Cement 50n, 5 inches wadded and placed at the end of plenum [3] (note B).

notes: B: 5 inches to be wadded & placed as shown.

Water test: a severe water test can push water in through the rear plenum vents; this is to be ignored. With correct installation and normal water exposure no water gets in (ref. GM water separation test).
